paragraphs: Shimon ben Guda–Gudaʿ. (A tanna cited in a baraita.)

In [Avodah Zarah 32a](https://www.sefaria.org/Avodah_Zarah.32a.9), Shimon ben Gudaʿ testified before Rabban Gamliel’s son that Rabban Gamliel had drunk from it in Akko. Tosafot there writes that he testified before Rabbi Chanina ben Gamliel, the brother of Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel, Rabbi’s father. The Tosefta there, chapter 5, however, explicitly says that he testified before the son of Rabban Gamliel the Elder, and gives the name Shimon ben Gudya. The Gemara there also says: “Alternatively, Gudaʿ is one person and Guda is another” (two tannaim).[^1][^2]

notes.text: The forms גודא, גודע and גודיא are rendered Guda, Gudaʿ and Gudya.

[Tosefta Avodah Zarah 5:4](https://www.sefaria.org/Tosefta_Avodah_Zarah.5.4) says that he testified before Rabban Gamliel’s son *in the name of* Rabban Gamliel the Elder; Hyman instead says before the Elder’s son.
